rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The analysis is well-structured, well-evidenced in form, and correctly identifies the cascade nature of most errors and the relevant .NET-Core-only APIs. However, the central conclusion is inverted: it asserts the failing compilation is the net10.0 leg receiving a corrupted reference surface, when the actual root cause is that the net472 leg legitimately lacks these APIs. This leads to a speculative ref-pack-conflict story and misdirected remediation. The agent did honestly flag its evidence gap, and one of its 'where to look' suggestions (guard HotReload sources for net472) accidentally points at the real fix, but the stated root cause is wrong. Execution also wasted several turns on tooling/output-truncation issues.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
